Auto plain conversion with accessible names disabled

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert_with_accessible_names(html = "<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", use_accessible_names = FALSE, options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("inline_data_media" = "alt_text_only", "output_format" = "plain", "tier_strategy" = "auto"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
